create_OpenAIServingTokenize: create an OpenAIServingTokenize instance to tokenize text prompts into token IDs
build_OpenAIServingDetokenize: build an OpenAIServingDetokenize instance to decode token IDs back into text strings
run_tokenize_single_prompt: run tokenization on a single string prompt and return token IDs and count
run_tokenize_batch_prompts: run tokenization on a list of string prompts and return per-prompt token IDs and counts
run_detokenize_tokens: run detokenization on a list of integers or list of lists of integers to produce decoded text
